# Jixiang Gloves

> > Fujian Jixiang E-commerce Co., Ltd. manufactures and distributes medical-grade and industrial disposable gloves including nitrile, latex, and vinyl examination gloves with international certifications (EN455, ASTM D6319, ASTM D6978, FDA 510K).

Based in Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China, Jixiang specializes in powder-free, latex-free disposable gloves for medical examination and industrial applications. The company offers OEM wholesale services and maintains certifications including CE EU, FDA, HALAL, and compliance with GB standards.

## Key Topics

- EN455 certification
- ASTM D6319 and ASTM D6978 standards
- Nitrile gloves
- Latex gloves
- Vinyl (PVC) gloves
- Powder-free gloves
- Latex-free gloves
- Medical examination gloves
- Non-sterile disposable gloves
- EN374 chemical protection
- FDA 510K approval
- GB 10213-2006 and GB 24786-2009 standards
- OEM wholesale manufacturing
- Diamond texture grip
- Xiamen, Fujian Province production

- [Powder Free Disposable Black Nitrile Gloves](https://www.jxgloves.com/powder-free-disposable-black-nitrile-gloves): Black nitrile gloves with diamond texture, EN374/EN455 certified
